The turn-1 prime is domain-separated from the pairs by design (bakery vs. the reasoning stems) specifically to avoid vocabulary overlap driving the turn-2 pick. That it is domain-separated is a design choice, not a demonstration that it carries no effect.
The gate fired on the exist cell at 2/12. A stop taken on a pre-committed gate is the strongest form this evidence takes, but it is still n=12 in that cell.

Inherits the 0815 arm's lexical-leak confound where the same pairs are reused: redaction left 'black' in 10/24 of 4.6-authored rationales. The self-minus-judge subtraction absorbs it; RAW accuracies do not.
